actual_Boolean_family: F=2 U(X)V(Y)-1, U=AND of disjoint OR clauses, V=OR of disjoint AND clauses on an independent equal-width-pattern copy
domain: Complete Boolean tables for base widths [2,2] and [2,3], hence F on8 and10 bits; all signed prime faces of BOTH polarities; all squared Walsh coefficients and physical influences. Analytic-family moment cases w=4..8, r=2^w, t in {0,r/2,r}.
case_count: 2 complete product truth tables, 6561+59049 signed faces tested for each polarity, 256+1024 spectral coefficients,15 analytic-family parameter cases. Pilot only widths[2,2] and first3 analytic cases.
symmetry: None for truth/prime checks; whole-block permutations identify a fixed t pattern for analytic cases, while the proof covers arbitrary patterns.
arithmetic: Integer bitset truth-face classification and Walsh transform; exact Fraction spectral factors, pivotal influences and lower bounds. No floating signs.
scope: Each polarity can use arbitrary independently optimized packing and covers. No claim about output-mass mixtures of both polarity queues. This is an explicitly frozen new product mechanism, not automatic enlargement of the previous search.
